title: Scheme theoretic image of a reduced scheme
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $U$ reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. The scheme-theoretic image of $f$, meaning the smallest closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] of $X$ through which $f$ factors, is the reduced induced closed subscheme on the topological closure $\overline{f(|U|)}$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. In particular, the scheme-theoretic closure of a reduced open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ equals the reduced induced closed subscheme on $\overline{|U|}$.

source.place: Tag 056B (lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced); scheme-theoretic closure is the image of the open immersion (definition-scheme-theoretically-dense).

proof.text: Put $T=\overline{f(|U|)}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme], there is a reduced closed subscheme $i_T:T_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ with underlying image $T$. Since $U$ is reduced and $f(|U|)\subseteq T$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-source-factors-through-closed-subscheme] to $f$ and $i_T$. It gives a morphism $g:U\to T_{\mathrm{red}}$ with $i_T\circ g=f$.

source.place: Tag 056B (lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced), proof lines 983-987, citing Schemes Tag 0356 (lemma-map-into-reduction), lines 2268-2289

proof.text: Let $z:Z\to X$ be any closed subscheme through which $f$ factors. Then $f(|U|)\subseteq z(|Z|)$, and $z(|Z|)$ is closed by [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Hence $T\subseteq z(|Z|)$. The scheme $T_{\mathrm{red}}$ is reduced by [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-source-factors-through-closed-subscheme] to $i_T:T_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ and $z$ to obtain a factorization of $i_T$ through $z$. Thus $i_T$ is contained in every closed subscheme through which $f$ factors. Together with Step 1, this is the defining minimality of the scheme-theoretic image.

source.place: Tag 056B (lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced), proof lines 983-987, using Schemes Tag 0356 (lemma-map-into-reduction) for the map from T_red

proof.text: For a reduced open subscheme U⊂X, take f to be its open immersion. Its underlying image is |U|, and by definition its scheme-theoretic closure is the scheme-theoretic image of this immersion. The first two steps therefore identify that closure with the reduced induced closed subscheme on the topological closure of |U|.

lean.statement: theorem schemeTheoreticImage_reduced (U X : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ X) [IsReduced U] : IsClosedImmersion f.imageι ∧ IsReduced f.image ∧ f.ker = vanishingIdeal (TopologicalSpace.Closeds.mk (closure (Set.range f)) isClosed_closure) ∧ Set.range f.imageι = closure (Set.range f) ∧ ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i], (∃ g : U ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = f) → ∃! h : f.image ⟶ Z, h ≫ i = f.imageι
